purpose: Separate Korean document answer finding from dialogue training
sampling: All rows weight 1; no conversation rows, no class rebalancing
loss_normalization: Mean CE within each answer, then equal mean over examples, including EOS
validation: 292 internal validation examples, example-mean loss every 200 steps; best loss checkpoint
generation_evaluation: Same fixed prompt+64 output-token budget as previous candidate; 135 answerable and 62 unanswerable eligible internal validation questions expected
comparison_limit: Dataset mixture and loss normalization both change; this experiment cannot attribute results to either factor alone. Loss numbers use a different normalization from the mixed run and are not directly comparable.
activation: No automatic activation. Inspect actual generation before deciding.
test_policy: Official dev test split not used for pilot training, selection or evaluation. Internal validation is diagnostic, not an untouched benchmark.
lineage: Own randomly initialized model lineage. No external model weights or generation APIs.
